what.text: A desktop application that is a graphical fugaro watch: live run monitoring and spending graphs. It has no backend, no service account, no database client and no credential of its own — the CLI is the data plane.

released.text: The console ships for macOS only, as one universal disk image and one archive, signed with a Developer ID certificate and notarised by Apple. Install the CLI first: the CLI is the data plane, and the console runs its read-only commands. The SHA-256 the release published is printed beside each download, and the command below prints the same line for the file you downloaded.

not_released.text: Not released yet. The console is built for macOS and has not been published: this section carries no download link until its own release exists.

properties.title: Strictly read-only
properties.text: Every command the console runs is a read-only CLI command, and the commands that write — kill, resume and cancel — stay in the CLI, with the CLI's own typed confirmations, admin check and compare-and-set.

properties.title: No telemetry
properties.text: No telemetry, no crash reporting to a third party, no analytics, and no update check that carries an identifier: its only outbound requests are the CLI's own, to the cloud the operator already owns, and the update check itself.

properties.title: Its own artifact
properties.text: The console ships as its own artifact, published from the CLI's own vX.Y.Z tag — one release train and one gate — with the range of CLI versions it was built against declared and checked at startup.
